name: optimaizr
description: optimAIzr inside Claude Code: what the turn has cost and your 5-hour window while Claude works, what each model switch saved, the model and effort switches you accept in `optimaizr live` applied from the next request, and a guard against retry loops. Fully local.

turnLine.title: Line under each answer
turnLine.description: Show what each turn cost, how many requests it made and how far your 5-hour window moved.

retryGuard.title: Hold repeated failing commands
retryGuard.description: When the same command fails twice in a row with nothing changed in between, hold the next identical attempt once and ask Claude to change something first.
